purpose: Call-to-action control rendered as <a> when href is given, else <button type=button>.

size.description: The source key is lg; it is the "default" size

icon.description: Optional lucide icon component rendered in a size-4 span after the label (e.g. ChevronRight)

variants.name: outline
variants.description: 1px border secondary-foreground, transparent bg, hover:bg secondary-foreground at 10%

variants.name: lg
variants.description: h-button, justify-between, gap-1.5, rounded-lg, px-5, text-sm

variants.name: sm
variants.description: h-button-sm, justify-center, gap-1, rounded-sm, px-3, text-xs

motion.reducedMotionNote: Source has no prefers-reduced-motion handling; proposal only.

notes: buttonClass({variant,size,className}) returns the same class string for non-Button elements such as submit buttons and navbar links (ui.jsx:52-54; Form.jsx:94).
